item.title: AI-Assisted Coding Reaches 29% of New US Software Code
item.description: Edited by Asim BN. Reviewed by Ayaz KhanGenerative AI is reshaping software development – and fast. A new study published in Science shows that AI-assisted coding is spreading rapidly, though unevenly: in the U.S., the share of new code relying on AI rose from 5% in 2022 to 29% in early 2025, compared with just 12% in China.
